Jinx

the Loose Cannon

Jinx swaps between a minigun and a rocket launcher, and every takedown sends her into a frenzy of speed and attack speed. She's a classic hyper-carry: steady in lane, dangerous after two items, and capable of wiping whole teams late. A great pick if you love teamfights.

When to pick Jinx

✓ Safe blind pick

Fairly safe. She scales into any game, but needs a calm lane to get there.

Pick into

  • Grouped teams where her rockets and resets shine
  • Low-range marksmen she out-scales, like Ezreal and Kai'Sa
  • Long games where she becomes a hyper-carry
  • Teams with weak dive

Avoid into

  • Hyper-scaling lanes that match her, like Twitch and Kog'Maw
  • Assassins and divers who reach her without a dash
  • Early-game lane bullies that keep her from farming

Great teammates

BraumBraum's shield and peel protect Jinx.
BlitzcrankBlitzcrank sets up kills for her.
ThreshThresh gives her peel and engage.

Your team needs: Pick Jinx when your team can protect her from divers and play for late fights.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Some of the highest late-game damage in the game, single target (minigun) and area (rockets)
  • Get Excited! lets her chain kill after kill in teamfights
  • Zap! and Flame Chompers! give her a slow, a reveal and a root for peel
  • Super Mega Death Rocket! is a global execute for finishing low enemies anywhere

Weaknesses

  • No dash or blink: if a diver reaches her, she relies on Flash and her team
  • Weaker early than lane bullies like Caitlyn or Draven
  • Rockets drain mana, so careless rocket use leaves her empty
  • Slightly weaker this patch after base stat nerfs in 26.21, so she needs a clean lane

Power spikes

  • Level 2: Zap plus a rocket auto gives safe poke
  • Level 6: Super Mega Death Rocket threatens kills on any low enemy
  • First item (Hexoptics C44): long-range damage and bonus range after takedowns, perfect with rockets
  • Two items (Runaan's Hurricane): minigun attacks hit extra targets and shred groups
  • Three items (Infinity Edge): you're a true hyper-carry who can win fights alone

Top tips

  • Farm with the minigun, poke with rockets, and don't forget to swap back
  • Chompers land best on a target who is already stunned or slowed
  • Get Excited! also triggers on towers and epic monsters: chain objectives together
  • Rocket range lets you hit things from a safer distance in teamfights
  • Fire your ultimate from far away for more damage
  • Throw Chompers between you and divers instead of using them aggressively
